name: Highland Terrace
title: Highland Terrace Window Cleaning, Lakeway TX | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for Highland Terrace in Rough Hollow. Ridge top homes near the Highland Village amenity center, exterior windows $10 each. Text for a quote.
intro: Highland Terrace is a ridge top section of Rough Hollow, near the Highland Village amenity center and its lazy river. CleanzATX cleans windows here for owners who want predictable, regular service.

paragraphs: Highland Terrace came in the 2018 to 2019 phase and sits near Highland Village, the amenity hub for Rough Hollow. Homes are production built, with more consistent floor plans than the custom hilltop sections. Prices run around $700K to $1.2M. It is not gated.

Repeating floor plans help us. We know roughly how many windows to expect and where the tall ones are, so quotes are fast and accurate. Many homes have an upper floor with a bank of windows over the front door and a rear living area with large glass.

sections.h2: What Highland Terrace windows deal with
paragraphs: A short walk to the amenity center means active households and plenty of foot traffic, so front glass gets handprints and fingerprints. Rear glass collects dust and pollen from the ridge. Builders also leave residue on newer glass.

Sprinklers matter too. Newer production lots have small yards, so the heads sit close to the house and spray the lower panes. Hard water removal is $10 per pane. Screens and tracks are $5 each, and we usually recommend doing them together.

Because the plans repeat, we move quickly and the visit is easy to predict. Highland Terrace is close to Canyon Pass and Arroyo Divide, so one morning can cover several homes. Parking is straightforward and the HOA allows normal service work.

A 3,000 sq ft home is about $300 for exterior windows, taking around two to two and a half hours outside. Inside adds about 90 minutes. With a Twice a Year plan you save 10%, and members on higher plans also receive a free yearly screen clean.

why: Repeating floor plans make quotes quick and accurate
Fingerprints and dust cleaned from active family homes
Close to Canyon Pass and Arroyo Divide for same morning routing
Handles hard water on small lots with close sprinkler heads

faq.q: Are all Highland Terrace plans the same?
faq.a: Many share similar plans, but each home has its own window count and upgrades. We quote by window count or square footage, and a text with your address is enough to start.

faq.q: Do you clean screens in the same visit?
faq.a: Yes. Screens are $5 each, full screens $10 and solar screens $15. We take them down, clean them and set them back.
Our lead time is usually within two weeks. We never promise same day service, but we give you a clear window.

faq.q: Do you offer plans for smaller yards?
faq.a: Yes. All Clean Windows Club plans work the same regardless of lot size. Twice a Year saves 10%, Triannual 15%, Quarterly 15% and Every 2 Months 20%.
